stories.title: Wimbledon 2026
stories.body: Jannik Sinner defends the men's singles title (beat Alexander Zverev 6-7, 7-6, 6-3, 6-4 on 12 July); Linda Nosková wins the women's singles (beat Karolína Muchová 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 on 11 July); men's doubles Heliövaara/Patten; women's doubles Guo Hanyu/Mladenovic; mixed doubles Arévalo/Ostapenko.

one_liners: Wimbledon 2026 — Jannik Sinner defends the men's singles title (beat Alexander Zverev 6-7, 7-6, 6-3, 6-4 on 12 July)
